name: LLMSX Explorer
task: Research a subject and keep the evidence
description: Browse the concept tree, inspect references and collect notes in a terminal research workbench.
requirements: Python 3.11+ and a terminal. The first launch needs internet access to clone the concept tree.
alt: LLMSX Explorer showing a concept outline beside source-linked facts and research controls.
first: Open a familiar concept, inspect its Facts tab and follow one source. Save a useful line to the scratchpad, then read it back.
features: Browse the concept tree and its published references.
Keep local notes, highlights and a scratchpad.
Organize research jobs when a configured runner is available.
limits: Browsing is local and needs no model credential. Research and other model-backed actions require your own configured runner and may incur costs. A source link does not establish that a claim is correct.
relatedLabel: Choose useful context for an agent

name: Skills Explorer
task: Maintain the skills already on your machine
description: Read, edit and organize installed agent skills across harnesses from one terminal workbench.
requirements: macOS or Linux with Homebrew for the recommended install. A terminal at least 120 columns by 35 rows is recommended.
alt: Skills Explorer showing installed skills and their supporting files beside the skill reader.
first: Launch skillsx from a project directory. Select one installed skill and follow a supporting reference. Use Read, Source and Metadata to inspect what your agent receives.
features: Browse supported local skill roots and follow references.
Edit with backups and recoverable trash.
Inspect metadata and run separately configured optimizers or evaluations.
limits: Reading and editing work without a model key. Optimizer and evaluation integrations require the matching installed skills, agents or runners. Token estimates and runtime measurements are different fields; missing telemetry stays unavailable.

name: GitHub Explorer
task: Work in a repository with Vim and GitHub CLI
description: Browse files, edit in embedded Vim and inspect Git and GitHub commands before running them.
requirements: macOS or Linux with Homebrew, Git and Vim. Install and authenticate GitHub CLI for authenticated GitHub actions.
alt: GitHub Explorer with repository files, an embedded Vim editor and GitHub command controls.
first: Run it from a repository checkout. Select a local text file to inspect it in Vim. Open the command catalog and review a command before executing it.
features: Browse tracked and untracked files in a local checkout.
Edit text using Vim's modes and save commands.
Discover Git and GitHub CLI actions alongside branch status.
limits: This is a companion developer tool. It does not replace skill or reference management. Remote repositories without a matching checkout have read-only previews. GitHub actions require your own authenticated gh CLI.
relatedLabel: Looking for skill maintenance? See Skills Explorer
